purpose_text.para: Configuration of Fine-grained Dynamic Traps for EL2 execution.
The controls selected by FGDTIndex 2n and 2n+1 are represented in this register.
Each 64-bit register is made up of two 32-bit registers with fields described below.
The low half of the register contains the controls used when FGDTIndex is 2n. The upper half of the register contains the controls used when FGDTIndex is 2n+1.
FGDTP<n>_EL2 is permitted to be cached in an IRT PLB as part of an IRT entry that specifies the corresponding FGDTIndex value n.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
At EL2, write accesses to the following mask registers that would be UNDEFINED when the mask is nonzero, instead perform direct write accesses to the following registers:

listitem.content: ACTLRMASK_EL2.
SCTLRMASK_EL2, SCTLR2MASK_EL2.
TCR_EL2, TCR2_EL2.
TCRMASK_EL2 and TCR2MASK_EL2.
CPTRMASK_EL2.
If FEAT_SRMASK2 is implemented, HCRMASK_EL2, and HCRXMASK_EL2.

field_description.para: If E0 is 1, this field is RES0.

field_value_description.para: The accesses remain UNDEFINED.
Write accesses to the specified mask registers perform the direct write access.

field_description.para: Write accesses at EL2 to any register name for which there is an NVMem[] offset, and the register name is not listed for the nVTT control is trapped.

In all cases the trap is reported using EC syndrome value 0x18 for MSR accesses and EC syndrome value 0x14 for MSRR accesses, and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1. This trap is higher priority than other traps. From EL2, the exception is taken to EL2.
If E0 is 1, this field is RES0.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.
Accesses to the specified registers at EL2 are trapped to EL2.

field_description.para: Writes to the following registers are trapped:

listitem.content: V(S)TCR_EL2, V(S)TTBR_EL2, VNCR_EL2, VNCCR_EL2.

field_description.para: Writes to HCR_EL2.VM are ignored.
The trap is reported using EC syndrome value 0x18 for MSR accesses and EC syndrome value 0x14 for MSRR accesses, and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1. This trap is higher priority than other traps.
If E0 is 1, this field is RES0.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.

field_description.para: Disables use of the PAC D B key for any PACDB signing instruction, as well as preventing use of any PAC authentication instructions that use the D B key, which are trapped in the same manner as for nSKDB.
Additionally accesses to APDBKeyHi_EL1 and APDBKeyLo_EL1 are reported using EC syndrome value 0x18 if accesses to the register are not already UNDEFINED.
This trap is higher priority than any other trap.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.
Accesses to the specified registers and instructions at EL2 are trapped to EL2.

The effect of this control on trapping ERETAB instructions is reported with higher priority than other traps on ERET instructions.
Additionally accesses to APIBKeyHi_EL1 and APIBKeyLo_EL1 are reported using EC syndrome value 0x18 if accesses to the register are not already UNDEFINED.
This trap is higher priority than any other trap.

field_description.para: Trap write accesses to TPIDR3_EL2. The exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x18 and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1.
These traps are higher priority than the traps due to HFGWTR2_EL2.TPIDR3_ELx and FGWTE3_EL3.TPIDR_EL3.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.

field_description.para: Traps the TCHANGEF and TCHANGEB instructions. The Illegal TIndex Change exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x2E and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.
Accesses to the specified registers at EL2 are trapped to EL2.

field_description.para: Forces execution at EL2 to look like EL0 in only the following manners:

listitem.content: Access to any system or special-purpose register, and execution of any system instruction behaves as though it were executed at EL0 with HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} == {1, 1}, with the one special case that read accesses to TPIDR_EL2 and TPIDR3_EL2 are still permitted.
Execution of any GCS system instruction still behaves as though executed at EL2.
The SMC instruction is UNDEFINED, and this has higher priority than the HCR_EL2.TSC and SCR_EL3.SMD controls.
The HVC instruction is UNDEFINED, and this has higher priority than the HCR_EL2.HCD and SCR_EL3.HCE controls.

field_description.para: However, it does not affect the permissions model or other behaviors. For example:

listitem.content: The effect of PSTATE.PAN still applies.
Execute and data access permissions are still evaluated as though execution is at EL2.
This bit does not affect trapping of other instructions that are not direct accesses to System registers, system instructions or the instructions listed here.
This bit does not prevent accesses to SP_ELx in cases where SP is used as an operand for an instruction.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception
Accesses to the specified registers are trapped.

field_description.para: Traps the ERET, ERETAA, and ERETAB instructions. The exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x1A and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1.

At EL2 traps write accesses to the following registers:

listitem.content: TTBRn_EL2, TCR_EL2, TCR2_EL2.
PIR_EL2, PIRE0_EL2, POR_EL2.
MAIR_EL2, MAIR2_EL2, AMAIR_EL2, AMAIR2_EL2.
DPOTBRn_EL2, IRTBRp_EL2, TTTBRp_EL2.
FGDTpn_EL2, AFGDTpn_EL2.

If FEAT_TRBE is implemented, TRBMAR_EL1.
If FEAT_TRBE is implemented and TRBLIMITR_EL1.nVM is 1: TRBBASER_EL1, TRBLIMITR_EL1, TRBPTR_EL1.

field_description.para: At EL2 accesses to the following registers and fields are RO:

listitem.content: If FEAT_SPE is implemented, MDCR_EL2.E2PB.
If FEAT_SPE_nVM is implemented, PMBLIMITR_EL1.nVM and PMSCR_EL2.EnVM.
If FEAT_TRBE is implemented, MDCR_EL2.E2TB and TRBLIMITR_EL1.nVM.
If FEAT_TRBEv1p1 is implemented, TRFCR_EL2.DnVM.
SCTLR_EL2.M.

field_description.para: If E0 is 1, this field is RES0.
The trap is reported using EC syndrome value 0x18 for MSR accesses and EC syndrome value 0x14 for MSRR accesses, and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1.
This trap has higher priority than any trap by a higher Exception level.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.

field_description.para: Traps the described instructions relating to FEAT_MTE.
For a trapped MSR access to TCO, the exception is reported with EC syndrome value 0x18 and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1.
Otherwise, the exception is reported with EC syndrome value 0x0A, and:

listitem.content: For loads and stores of Allocation Tags, ISS=0x000005.
For IRG, ADDG and SUBG, ISS=0x000009.

field_description.para: The exception is taken regardless of whether the target memory location has the Tagged attribute.
For the SETG* tag setting instructions, this trap has lower priority than the existing MSCEn trap controls.

field_value_description.para: This control does not generate an exception.
Any instruction that loads or stores Allocation Tags is trapped.
As 0b01 and MSR access to TCO is trapped.
As 0b10 and IRG, ADDG and SUBG are trapped.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.

Accesses to APGAKeyHi_EL1 and APGAKeyLo_EL1 are trapped using EC syndrome value 0x18 and ESR_EL2.ISS.FGDT is 1 if accesses to the register are not already UNDEFINED.
This trap is higher priority than any other trap on PACGA instructions.
